title: Change one chord at a time
summary: A progression puts chords in order.

steps.title: Change one chord at a time
steps.body:
**chord progression** means a series of chords played one after another. I–V–I in G means G, then D, then G again.

**Why it matters:** Chord order gives a song movement and a way to return home.

steps.title: See it on the fretboard
steps.body: Use the G and D open shapes you already learned. The current chord is highlighted during practice. The app clears tap selections after each correct chord.

steps.title: Explore the sounds
steps.body: Move slowly from G to D. You can use other correct positions and octaves. Use taps for these simultaneous chord checks; the microphone hears one note at a time.

items.prompt: In G major, which chord is the V?
